description: DFT relaxed V0 coordinates, PBC distance calculation

modelc_v3._note: Li-Cl split by Cl site: 4a (n=36) vs 4d anti-site (n=4). 4d-Cl 0.19 A shorter.

icohp_LOBSTER_ext_basis_eV_per_bond._method: LOBSTER 5.1.1, PAW kjpaw_psl 1.0.0 pseudo, ecutwfc=70 Ry, NSCF nbnd 450 (comp1) / 500 (modelc_v3), wf_collect, nosym. Extended basis: Li 1s 2s 2p, P/S/Cl 3s 3p 3d. Charge spilling < 1.5% for both. Paper-grade absolute values.
icohp_LOBSTER_ext_basis_eV_per_bond._convention: ICOHP < 0 = bonding. Per-bond average over all bonds within 4.0 Å cutoff (cohpGenerator).

headline_comparison.Li-Cl_delta_pct: +13.4% (LPSCl1.6 stronger; driven by short 4d-Cl Li-Cl bonds and overall Cl-rich ionic field)
headline_comparison.Li-S_delta_pct: +7.9% (LPSCl1.6 stronger; vacancy concentrates remaining Li-S bonds)
headline_comparison.P-S_delta_pct: +0.9% (~unchanged; PS4 backbone robust to Cl substitution)
headline_comparison.paper_message: Vacancy + Cl substitution STRENGTHENS rather than weakens ionic bonding in LPSCl1.6. Wilkening ionic potential framework (q·|q|/r) consistent: shorter Li-Cl(4d) bonds = larger ICOHP magnitude.

trends.Li-Br_vs_Li-Cl: Li-Br 0.10-0.26 A longer in all compositions
trends.P-S_constant: ~2.06 A across all compositions (PS4 framework invariant)
trends.basin_effect: Li-Br differs by 0.012 A between basins (comp5)

physics.longer_bond_weaker: Longer Li-Br -> weaker ionic interaction -> lower B0/E
